description: List all available verified tax/accounting rule keys for the active company's country (every live country has a library), optionally filtered by category. Use this when you need to find the right key for lookup_tax_rule.

category.description: Optional category filter. UK categories: vat, corporation_tax, self_assessment, paye, mtd, companies_house, dividends, directors, expenses, capital_gains, capital_allowances, pensions, income_tax, national_insurance, rd_relief. UAE categories: corporate_tax, vat, excise_tax, free_zones, esr, ubo, payroll, compliance. Omit to list all.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

country.description: ISO country code of the business, such as GB, IE or US. Pass it when the user has not connected AccountsOS. Once connected, leave it out and their company's country is used.

name: list_tax_rules
title: List Tax Rules
